title.zh: 建筑管制（豁免军事建筑与建筑工程）命令 2008
title.en: Building Control (Exempt Military Buildings and Building Works) Order 2008

title.id: Perintah Pengendalian Bangunan (Bangunan Militer dan Pekerjaan Bangunan Militer yang Dikecualikan) 2008
title.ms: Perintah Kawalan Bangunan (Bangunan Tentera dan Kerja Bangunan Tentera yang Dikecualikan) 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Building Control (Exempt Military Buildings and Building Works) Order 2008 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 15th February 2008.
2. In this Order, “building” does not include part of a building.

3. Every building ––
(a)that is owned by the Government for the purposes of the Ministry of Defence or the Singapore Armed Forces; and
(b)that is ––
(i)marked or classified by the Ministry of Defence or the Singapore Armed Forces other than as “Restricted” in their documents or maps; or
(ii)situated within any area that is marked or classified by the Ministry of Defence or the Singapore Armed Forces as “Secret” or “Confidential” in their documents or maps,
shall be exempt from all of the provisions of the Act.

4. All building works that are carried out ––
(a)by or on behalf of the Government for the purposes of the Ministry of Defence or the Singapore Armed Forces; and
(b)on or in relation to any building referred to in paragraph 3,
shall be exempt from all of the provisions of the Act.
